hero.title: Ha Tinh: Discover Hidden Beauty
hero.description: From pristine beaches and majestic landscapes to historic landmarks rich in heritage, Ha Tinh invites you to embark on a unique and unforgettable journey.

welcome.heading: Discover a Land of Heritage and Talent
welcome.description: Ha Tinh captivates visitors not only with the poetic Lam River and the majestic Hoanh Son Mountain Range, but also with its rich cultural heritage, warm hospitality, and distinctive local cuisine.

about.heading: Where the Sea Meets the Mountains
about.paragraph_1: Located in Vietnam’s sun-drenched central region, Ha Tinh boasts a stunning coastline with famous beaches such as Thien Cam and Xuan Thanh, alongside nationally significant historical sites including Dong Loc Junction and the Memorial Site of the Great Poet Nguyen Du.
about.paragraph_2: A visit to Ha Tinh is a chance to experience the soulful melodies of Vi and Giam folk songs, recognized by UNESCO as an Intangible Cultural Heritage, while enjoying a peaceful atmosphere that reconnects visitors with nature and history.

timeline.heading: Tourism Development Timeline
timeline.subtitle: The journey of Ha Tinh’s tourism growth
timeline.phase_1_desc: Focused on preserving key historical landmarks and uncovering the potential of pristine coastal destinations.
timeline.phase_2_desc: Major investments in transportation networks and the expansion of resorts in Thien Cam and Xuan Thanh.
timeline.phase_3_desc: Promoting Vi and Giam folk culture globally while integrating smart tourism maps and digital experiences.
timeline.phase_4_desc: Advancing eco-tourism and community-based tourism while preserving the region’s natural environment.

cta.heading: Plan Your Ha Tinh Adventure
cta.description: Don’t miss the opportunity to experience Ha Tinh’s tranquil beauty, enjoy the melodies of Vi and Giam folk songs, and savor the famous Cu Do peanut candy.
